li.label: a fire in my room
li.description: There's a fire burning a few steps from my bed. I fall asleep warm and wake up warm.

li.label: books on a proper shelf
li.description: Our books are on a proper shelf now instead of stacked on the floor. I keep straightening the spines.

li.label: new books to read
li.description: There are books in the colony I haven't read yet. I'm trying to make them last.

li.label: somewhere to train
li.description: I can practice properly between raids now. My arms ache, and I'm quicker than I was.

li.label: my baby has a proper bed
li.description: My little one sleeps in a real crib now, not a crate on the floor. I still get up to check, but not as often.

li.label: enough wood for winter
li.description: The woodpile is tall enough to get us to spring. I can stop counting logs in my head at night.

li.label: the animals will eat this winter
li.description: There's enough feed stacked to see the animals through winter. We won't have to slaughter any of them early.

li.label: honey in the larder
li.description: There's real honey in storage. I've had a spoonful already, and I'm thinking about a second.

li.label: a proper treasury
li.description: I went and looked at our silver today. There's a good pile of it now, and I like knowing it's there.

li.label: dressed for the cold
li.description: I finally own something that keeps the cold out. I can work outside without shivering.

li.label: a hat of my own
li.description: I have something on my head at last. It keeps the sun and rain off, and I think it suits me.

li.label: dressed finely
li.description: My clothes are finely made, and people look twice when I walk past.

li.label: a piece of jewelry
li.description: I'm wearing a lovely piece of jewelry. It catches the light whenever I move.

li.label: saw something of the world
li.description: I went out with a caravan and saw new places and new faces. I can't stop talking about it.

li.label: got what I had my eye on
li.description: We bought the thing I had my eye on from the trader. It belongs to the colony, but I think of it as mine.

li.label: the beast is dead
li.description: The animal that mauled one of us is dead. I can walk past the tree line again without my heart in my throat.

li.label: learned from the best
li.description: Someone who really knows the work took the time to teach me. I'm getting better at it every day.

li.label: flowers around the colony
li.description: There are flowers growing by the paths now, planted just for the look of them.

li.label: a place to pray
li.description: There's a shrine in the colony now, somewhere to kneel and say what I can't say to anyone else.

li.label: a proper bath
li.description: We have somewhere to get properly clean now. I soaked until my fingers wrinkled.

li.label: a way to keep the meat
li.description: We can cure meat now instead of watching it rot. None of the hunt goes to waste.

li.label: bees in the colony
li.description: We keep bees now. I can hear them humming over the fields on warm days.

li.label: a fountain in the colony
li.description: There's a fountain in the colony now. I like to stop by it and listen to the water.

li.label: our colors are flying
li.description: Our banner flies over the colony now. Anyone coming over the hill can see who lives here.

li.label: an orderly armory
li.description: Our weapons hang on a rack now, ready to grab. When the alarm goes, we won't be digging under beds for them.

li.label: more art in the colony
li.description: There's a new sculpture in the colony. I take the long way around just to see it.

li.label: somewhere to sit outside
li.description: There's a bench out in the open air now. Between jobs I can sit for a moment and watch the sky.
